overview.overview:
Maine's 2nd Congressional District is forecast to lean Republican in 2028, with an expected margin of about 4 points favoring the Republican side. The district voted Republican in 2020 by 7.4 points and in 2024 by 9.0 points, and it runs well to the right of the national baseline.

The range of plausible outcomes is wide, from a Republican edge of 14 points to a Democratic edge of 6 points, which reflects the uncertainty of a contest still years away. Because Maine awards one electoral vote for this district, its result is unlikely to decide the national outcome.
overview.watch: A notable shift in the national environment or a strong district-specific candidate effect could move the margin substantially.
